---
title: Runtime and Ratings
---



The relationship between film runtime and IMDb ratings. @fig-runtime-rating shows how ratings vary with runtime.


::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. Rating")
plt.show()
```

## Mean Rating by Decade

::: {#1ba40fa7 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
